value.rationale: Multiple possible burst lengths are a natural synchronization-channel uncertainty. Their diversity counts have individually known binomial laws and vanish in all cross covariances; the all-parameter nonzero third mixed cumulant only at additive length resonance is the first sharp structure in joint fluctuations. It distinguishes marginal descriptions from cross-scale behavior, with an exact finite-size coefficient and no arbitrary parameter slice.
